## Final review

- [ ] All intended changes have been pushed and local validation is complete.
- [ ] After the final push, mark the PR ready, then add the `review-ready` label
      exactly once to start the CodeRabbit review. If the label was added while
      the PR was a draft, mark it ready, remove the label, and add it again.
      Contributors without label permission must ask a maintainer to apply it.
- [ ] Wait for the CodeRabbit check to finish before requesting owner approval.

Do not use a full review, GitHub's **Re-request review** button, usage credits,
or repeated review commands. If the final head changes after review feedback,
request one incremental review only after all fixes have been pushed.
